description: WavLM base-plus fine-tuned 2-head classifier (age 6-class + gender 2-class), fp32 ONNX, split into chunks for GitHub Pages hosting. Concatenate part_0..part_7 in order to restore the file.
input: waveform: float32 [batch, samples], 16kHz mono, max 160000 samples used in training
outputs: age_probs (6: teens, twenties, thirties, fourties, fifties, sixties)
